name: apiverve-streetaddressparser
summary: Street Address Parser is an address parsing API that breaks raw US street addresses into structured location components. Pass any single-line address string to extract the building number, directional, street name, street type, unit, city, state abbreviation, and postal code. Set standardize=true to get the address type (street, PO box or intersection) free, and on paid plans the mailing-format delivery line, last line and ZIP+4.
